caseName: Anderson v. Atlantic Coast Line Railroad
caseNameFull: Anderson, Administratrix v. Atlantic Coast Line Railroad Co. and Swafford v. Atlantic Coast Line Railroad Co.
attorneys: Thomas J. Lewis and Richard M. Maxwell for petitioner in No. 143. Howard P. Macjarlane for petitioner in No. 261. William M. Howell for respondent in No. 143. G. L. Reeves, Norman C. Shepard and Frank G. Kurka for respondent in No. 261.
judges: Are, Burton, Cases, Frankfurter, Granted, Reed, Should

opinions.text:
On petitions for writs of certiorari to the

United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit.

Per Curiam:

The petitions for writs of certiorari in these cases are granted and the judgments are reversed.

Mr. Justice Reed, Mr. Justice Frankfurter, Mr. Justice Burton, and Mr. Justice Harlan are of the opinion that certiorari should not have been granted in these cases.
